notes: The sketch uses the built-in LED on D13; the external LED circuit is optional and is what is modelled here.

Breadboard holes were read from the circuit image: orange wire at column 3 (row g), resistor from column 3 to column 6 (row h), LED anode (long, bent leg) in column 6 and cathode in column 8 (row i), black GND wire at column 8 (row g). All are in the bottom half (bank b, rows f-j) of the upper block.
The black wire goes to the Uno GND pin next to pin 13 (in the header beside AREF), modelled as GND.1.
The resistor is 220 ohm, per the manual's text and schematic.
